review_text:
{
  "verdict": "split_required",
  "reason": "The changeset introduces over 3,000 lines of code across core domain logic, kernel integration, public APIs, and UI tooling. Reviewing this as a single PR poses a high risk of missing architectural flaws or security issues in the Layer8 Authority implementation. A phased review is necessary.",
  "proposed_slices": [
    {
      "name": "Slice 1: Core Layer8 Authority Domain Logic",
      "purpose": "Introduce the foundational data structures, audit, exchange, and identity logic for Layer8 Authority without wiring it into the active kernel control flow.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/layer8_authority/audit.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/layer8_authority/exchange.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/layer8_authority/identity.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/layer8_authority/mod.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/lib.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "validation": "Unit tests within the layer8_authority modules. Ensure it compiles without breaking existing kernel builds.",
      "risk": "Low (Isolated code, no active control flow changes)"
    },
    {
      "name": "Slice 2: Kernel Integration & Control Flow",
      "purpose": "Wire the Layer8 Authority into the kernel's assembly, control loop, and ingress mechanisms.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/assembly.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/bin/adl-runtime-kernel.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/control.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/ingress.rs",
        "adl-runtime-kernel/src/conversation_sessions_tests.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "Slice 1: Core Layer8 Authority Domain Logic"
      ],
      "validation": "Pass conversation_sessions_tests.rs and existing kernel test suites to ensure no regressions in standard control flow.",
      "risk": "High (Modifies core kernel control loop and ingress)"
    },
    {
      "name": "Slice 3: Runtime API & Integration Tests",
      "purpose": "Expose the Layer8 Authority feature through the CSM runtime API and provide high-level integration tests.",
      "paths": [
        "adl-runtime/src/layer8_authority.rs",
        "adl-runtime/src/lib.rs",
        "adl-runtime/tests/layer8_authority.rs",
        "adl/src/csm_runtime_api.rs",
        "adl/tests/layer8_authority_runtime_api.rs"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "Slice 2: Kernel Integration & Control Flow"
      ],
      "validation": "Pass adl-runtime/tests/layer8_authority.rs and adl/tests/layer8_authority_runtime_api.rs.",
      "risk": "Medium (Expands public API surface)"
    },
    {
      "name": "Slice 4: Observatory UI & Tooling",
      "purpose": "Add UI validation scripts and update the HTML observatory demo to support Layer8 Authority visibility.",
      "paths": [
        "adl/tools/validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh",
        "demos/html-observatory/app.js",
        "demos/html-observatory/styles.css"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "Slice 3: Runtime API & Integration Tests"
      ],
      "validation": "Successful execution of validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh and manual verification of the HTML observatory.",
      "risk": "Low (Tooling and demo updates only)"
    }
  ],
  "must_fix_before_publication": [
    "Decompose the branch into the proposed slices to allow isolated review of the core authority logic before reviewing the API and UI integrations.",
    "Do not merge or publish the current monolithic branch."
  ],
  "notes": "The separation of `layer8_authority` into its own module is clean, making it an ideal candidate for a foundational PR (Slice 1). The integration tests and UI tooling are substantial (+1200 LoC combined) and can easily follow once the core kernel logic is reviewed and merged."
}
